First-click Run POSTs the message to a public HTTPS echo (https://httpbingo.org/post) in json mode — no local server, no NanoGPT spend, no upload. The echo returns {data: <body>}; json mode shows that text.

To try the NanoGPT chat contract instead: set mode to chat, URL to http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/chat/completions, and start the 20-line mock in the Custom endpoint guide. Chrome may ask once for local-network access.
